name: The majority voted in favour of a [motion](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/debates/?id=2024-03-21.3.2) to agree with the main idea. In parliamentary jargon, they voted to read the bill for a second time. This means they can now consider it in greater detail. ### What is this bill's main idea? The [bills digest](https://www.aph.gov.au/Parliamentary_Business/Bills_Legislation/bd/bd2324a/24bd054) set out the following information on the bill: > *The purpose of the Administrative Review Tribunal Bill 2023 (ART Bill) is to establish the [Administrative Review Tribunal](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Administrative_Review_Tribunal) (the Tribunal), which will replace the [Administrative Appeals Tribunal](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Administrative_Appeals_Tribunal) (AAT). The ART Bill also details the Tribunal’s membership, structure, review procedures and other matters. It also re-establishes the Administrative Review Council.*
